title: 2008 AMC 10A Problem 13
statement: Doug can paint a room in \(5\) hours. Dave can paint the same room in \(7\) hours. Doug and Dave paint the room together and take a one-hour break for lunch. Let \(t\) be the total time, in hours, required for them to complete the job working together, including lunch. Which of the following equations is satisfied by \(t?\)

solutions.text:
Working together, Doug and Dave paint \(\dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{7}\) of the room per hour.

Because they break for one hour, they work for only \(t - 1\) hours, and this must complete the whole room:

\[ \left(\dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{7}\right)(t - 1) = 1. \]

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Together they paint \(\dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{7}\) of the room each working hour
They actually work for \(t - 1\) hours because of the one-hour lunch break
